metadata.description: F-16 — unproven window: pending ARB event at the compliant pre-settlement Confidence B declares finality_basis=optimistic_window but omits finality_eta, so the window is undated. FB-001: a basis whose registry entry sets requires_finality_eta must carry finality_eta — without it the event holds no reproducible evidence of when settlement is due. Expected: reject with FB-001. (The Confidence-A twin of this shape is already rejected at message level by SEM-015, F-14.)
